summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for the Myozyme (alglucosidase alfa) BLA 125141; the Medical Review states this in three places (L92, L233, L673) and the administrative correspondence records that a determination was made not to go to an Advisory Committee. Instead the application was discussed at an internal CDER Regulatory Briefing on March 3, 2006, and the review team's label/indication discussions were informed by that briefing and by a prior Endocrinologic and Metabolic Drugs Advisory Committee discussion of Inborn Errors of Metabolism trials (Jan 13-15, 2003). Because no AdComm was held for this application, there are no committee-to-change linkages.
